name: @pipeworx/mcp-cocktails

tools.name: search_cocktails
tools.description: Search TheCocktailDB for cocktail recipes by name. Returns name, category, alcoholic/non-alcoholic classification, glassware, thumbnail, and ingredient list with measurements (no preparation instructions — use get_cocktail for those).

query.description: Cocktail name or partial name to search for

tools.name: get_cocktail
tools.description: Get full cocktail recipe by ID. Returns ingredients with exact measurements, preparation steps, glassware type, and garnish.

tools.name: random_cocktail
tools.description: Get a random cocktail recipe. Returns ingredients with measurements, instructions, glassware, and garnish details.

tools.name: cocktails_by_ingredient
tools.description: List all TheCocktailDB cocktails that contain a specific ingredient (e.g., 'vodka', 'lime juice'). Returns cocktail id, name, and thumbnail only — use get_cocktail to retrieve full recipes.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cocktails forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cocktails pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
